CASES.case_note: Family 1 proband. Family-based CaseSharing demo case.
CASES.medical_chief_complaint: Progressive myopia and aortic root dilatation
CASES.medical_current_history: Tall stature became evident in late elementary school, and myopia progressed during adolescence. Ectopia lentis was identified at age 18, and echocardiography at age 23 showed aortic root dilatation.
CASES.medical_previous_history: Pectus excavatum was noted in childhood.
CASES.medical_process: Genetic testing identified a pathogenic FBN1 variant, confirming Marfan syndrome.
CASES.medical_physical_findings: Tall stature, arachnodactyly, pectus excavatum, and positive thumb sign.
CASES.medical_examination_findings: Laboratory tests: CRP 0.03 mg/dL, BNP 18 pg/mL. Ophthalmologic examination showed ectopia lentis, and echocardiography demonstrated a sinus of Valsalva diameter of 43 mm.
CASES.genotype_analysis: A connective tissue disorder gene panel identified a heterozygous pathogenic FBN1 variant.
CASES.family_history: The mother has a history of ectopia lentis and ascending aortic dilatation.
CASES.registration_note: Family 1 proband. Family-based CaseSharing demo case.

CASES.medical_physical_findings: Arachnodactyly, long limbs, and mild chest wall deformity.

CASES.genotype_analysis: Familial testing confirmed the same pathogenic FBN1 variant.
CASES.family_history: Her daughter shows similar body habitus abnormalities and aortic root dilatation.

CASES.medical_chief_complaint: Tall stature, myopia, and chest wall deformity

CASES.medical_process: Familial testing after the proband's diagnosis confirmed the same FBN1 pathogenic variant, leading to a diagnosis of Marfan syndrome.

CASES.case_note: Undiagnosed sharing-oriented case. Wilson disease-like phenotype with ATP7B as a candidate gene.
CASES.medical_current_history: Hand tremor and difficulty speaking began around age 10, and liver enzyme elevation has recurred in recent years.
CASES.medical_process: This remains an undiagnosed Wilson disease-like case. ATP7B is a candidate gene, and additional validation plus comparison with external cases are needed.
CASES.medical_examination_findings: Laboratory tests: AST 78 U/L, ALT 96 U/L, ceruloplasmin 17 mg/dL. Twenty-four-hour urinary copper was borderline.
CASES.genotype_analysis: Exome sequencing identified ATP7B as a candidate gene, but the case remains unsolved at present.
CASES.family_history: A younger brother has similar symptoms.
CASES.registration_note: Undiagnosed sharing-oriented case. Wilson disease-like phenotype with ATP7B as a candidate gene.

CASES.case_note: Undiagnosed sharing-oriented case. Familial cardiomyopathy candidate case.
CASES.medical_current_history: Recurrent exertional syncope started after university entrance, and echocardiography revealed septal hypertrophy, but no definitive diagnosis has been reached.
CASES.medical_process: This remains an undiagnosed hereditary cardiomyopathy case. MYH7 is a strong candidate, and family information plus comparison with similar cases may be informative.
CASES.medical_examination_findings: Laboratory tests: BNP 188 pg/mL, high-sensitivity troponin I 32 pg/mL. Echocardiography showed interventricular septal thickness of 17 mm.
CASES.genotype_analysis: A hereditary cardiomyopathy panel prioritized MYH7 as the leading candidate, but the case remains unsolved at present.
CASES.family_history: A younger sister also has syncopal episodes.
CASES.registration_note: Undiagnosed sharing-oriented case. Familial cardiomyopathy candidate case.

CASES.case_note: Sharing-oriented diagnosed case. Pathogenic MYH7 hypertrophic cardiomyopathy case.
CASES.medical_current_history: Exertional shortness of breath and presyncope recurred from the early twenties, and nonsustained ventricular tachycardia was documented in the thirties.
CASES.medical_process: A cardiomyopathy gene panel identified a pathogenic MYH7 variant, and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy was diagnosed.
CASES.medical_examination_findings: Laboratory tests: BNP 235 pg/mL, high-sensitivity troponin I 54 pg/mL. Echocardiography showed septal thickness of 20 mm.
CASES.genotype_analysis: A cardiomyopathy panel identified a pathogenic MYH7 variant.
CASES.family_history: The father died suddenly at a young age.
CASES.registration_note: Sharing-oriented diagnosed case. Pathogenic MYH7 hypertrophic cardiomyopathy case.

CASES.medical_current_history: Burning pain in the distal extremities appeared during adolescence, and angiokeratoma plus proteinuria developed in the late twenties.
CASES.medical_process: Reduced enzyme activity and a pathogenic GLA variant established the diagnosis of Fabry disease.
CASES.medical_physical_findings: Scattered angiokeratomas on the lower abdomen and reduced sweating.
CASES.medical_examination_findings: Laboratory tests: alpha-Gal A activity 0.8 nmol/hr/mg protein, creatinine 1.0 mg/dL, urine protein 1.2 g/gCr, NT-proBNP 420 pg/mL.
CASES.genotype_analysis: GLA testing identified a pathogenic missense variant.
CASES.family_history: The mother and younger sister have milder related symptoms.
